citations.description: test_bedrock_hosted_claude_gets_bedrock_cache_style_and_stays_prompted: asserts prompt_cache_style == 'bedrock' but does not call cache_settings_for()
boto3-gated test: only checks profile fields, not cache_settings_for() result
test_cache_settings_selected_from_style_and_absent_when_none: only tests anthropic and openai styles, not bedrock

findings.criterion: a test asserts a Bedrock-hosted Claude model yields `prompt_cache_style == "bedrock"` and that `cache_settings_for()` returns `BedrockModelSettings` with `bedrock_cache_instructions` and `bedrock_cache_tool_definitions` set — the Bedrock cache path has an executable proof, constructed offline with no AWS credentials
findings.detail: The test `test_bedrock_hosted_claude_gets_bedrock_cache_style_and_stays_prompted` asserts `caps.prompt_cache_style == "bedrock"` (line 144) but never calls `cache_settings_for()` on that capability to assert the returned `BedrockModelSettings` with `bedrock_cache_instructions` and `bedrock_cache_tool_definitions` set. The boto3-gated test `test_real_bedrock_profile_exposes_the_fields_the_stub_mimics` (lines 164-184) only checks profile fields, not `cache_settings_for()`. A search of all `cache_settings_for` call sites in tests confirms it is only called with `anthropic:claude-opus-4-8`, `openai:gpt-4o`, `google-gla:gemini-2.5-flash`, and `""` — never with a Bedrock-style capability. The second half of this AC (the `cache_settings_for()` → `BedrockModelSettings` assertion) is absent.
